_meta.purpose: Verified local-fact spine for AVA city hubs + city-trade landers. Every fact here is sourceable; NEVER invent a local fact, a local missed-call %, or a local job value. Consumed by the city hubs (Milwaukee/Madison/Green Bay + Kenosha/Racine/Appleton) so each page passes the swap test with real, city-specific data.
_meta.law: Seasonal call examples are labeled EXAMPLES, not measured local volume. Area codes are PSC/NANPA public record. Corridors, employers, and neighborhoods are public geography/economic-development record. Attribute in a visible 'Source notes' block on each page.

seasonMap.note: Wisconsin's four-season call map — regional, true, and the thing no competitor writes. Written generically here; each hub tailors it to its own trade mix.

winter.headline: No-heat calls at 2 AM
winter.phone: Sub-zero stretches turn a furnace failure into an emergency, not an appointment. Frozen and burst pipes. The phone rings in the middle of the night.

spring.headline: The thaw surfaces the damage
spring.phone: Snowmelt and rain expose what winter hid — wet basements, failed sump pumps, ice-dam roof damage coming due.

summer.headline: AC fails during the heat wave — all at once
summer.phone: When the heat index spikes, the phone doesn't ring evenly — it rings all at once. Storm damage clusters.
calls: AC failure during a heat wave

fall.headline: Beat the snow
fall.phone: Heating-season prep, tune-up bookings, and the last roof and exterior work before the first snow.
